title: Generic 2-pin power or battery connector (wire-to-board header, pigtail pads)
reference: skills/hw-design/references/interfaces.md §4 (JST PH rules PH-02, PH-04, PH-05) and §0.4; references/batteries.md §5 for pigtail polarity
sources: No standard assigns a signal to either pin: polarity is the pigtail vendor's, per interfaces.md §4.3. The default pin 1 = positive below is a convention, not a standard; state the real one in PARTS[ref].pin_map.

rules.text: The two pins are not shorted together.
The return pin carries the board's ground net: the polarity design.py states (pin_map) is the polarity the board is wired for.
The positive pin is not ground: a reversed pigtail or a swapped pin map.
A battery connector has a keyed, polarized shroud and a documented pigtail check, or a reverse-polarity element; record the choice (electronics.md §6).

notes: PH-01 (pitch and family) is kicad_fpcheck.py with a JST-PH-<n> PACKAGES entry, not this checker.
PH-03 (at most 2 A per pin) needs the power budget, which no netlist carries.
